confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated crowd-sourced indexes (Numbeo, GoTripZi, Mylifeelsewhere) that quote denars. I converted them at about 54 MKD per USD. Cocktail and wine were not found directly, so I set them relative to beer: cocktail about 1.8x beer, wine glass about 1x beer. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no booking pages checked, and Ohrid's July peak season could push them higher. For the FX, the search summary was internally inconsistent about the 19 Nov value, so I used the 18 Nov 2026 observation of 0.6720, which two parts of the result confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Ohrid is a lakeside tourist town in North Macedonia. Its prices are about 15-19% above the national average and are comparable to Balkan resort towns such as Kotor or Berat. Summer peak accommodation is priced above the off-season level.
